Technical study

How a gearbox earns its keep.

A gear train turns high speed and low torque into low speed and high torque. The housing keeps the pair meshed, aligned and lubricated — and the rest is engineering judgement about size, duty and service life.

  • Helical, bevel, worm and planetary configurations
  • Compact gearmotors to heavy-duty gear units
  • Shaft-mounted and foot-mounted arrangements
  • Combined planetary / helical heavy duty units
